notes.title: Bug Fix Regarding Weapon Reload
notes.content:
We want to extend our sincerest apologies for the frustration caused by the weapon reload issue. We understand how this bug disrupted your gameplay experience, and we deeply regret any annoyance it may have caused. 

Fixes:

Double Reloading Issue: We’ve addressed the rare issue where players could accidentally perform double reloads, disrupting gameplay. This bug has been thoroughly fixed to ensure smoother and more reliable weapon handling.

New Additions:

Music Player in Main Menu: Dive into the game’s atmosphere with our brand-new Music Player, now available directly in the main menu. Customize your experience by selecting your favorite background tracks, creating the perfect vibe for your battles.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think of the fixes and new features. Your input helps us make Popo & Rob even better!

notes.title: Welcome to Popo & Rob: A New Era of FPS Fun
notes.content:
Welcome to Popo & Rob! 

[previewyoutube=CxoqE8ZrDoY;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into a world where gravity bends to your will and creativity knows no bounds. Join the vibrant battles in Popo & Rob, where unique characters, dynamic movement, and endless possibilities come together to deliver a fresh, exciting FPS experience.

In Popo & Rob, you'll discover:

Gravity-Defying Combat: Walk on walls, ceilings, and any surface, creating unconventional strategies and exhilarating gameplay moments.

Team-Based Action: Choose from diverse characters with powerful abilities and weapons, each bringing a fresh twist to your gameplay style.

Endless Creativity: Navigate beautifully designed arenas where every corner holds new paths and surprises, making each match unique.

Casual-Friendly Experience: Whether you're a seasoned shooter fan or new to FPS games, Popo & Rob offers accessible mechanics with depth for all skill levels.

We invite you to dive in, explore, and join the growing community. Your feedback is invaluable to us—help shape the future of Popo & Rob with your thoughts, suggestions, and ideas. Together, let’s build something extraordinary!

See you in the arena!

~Hakai Games Studio
